items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Prez' only as a label from the interviewer; the interviewee's response discusses Benny Carter, Tommy Dorsey, and George Avakian, showing no personal connection or specific knowledge of Lester Young in this excerpt.

ctx.x: Yeah, God!, Benny Carter. Then he started . . . There’s a lot of records that he made with Tommy Dorsey, and a whole bunch of things. George Avakian was recording a lot in those days. He’s still around and still doing it, but he was a pretty young cat at that time. I’m glad we’re doing this thing at the festival, in tribute to Jimmy, because some of the people of that era, when they die, they just drop out of sight. I’ve never heard of Bobby . . . I’ve never heard anything by Bobby Hackett again since he died.
